description: This file contains Swagger annotations and class definitions for the Funds API resource in the Fineract project. It defines response and request data structures used for API documentation and schema generation.

classes.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container class for Swagger schema definitions related to the Funds API, including nested classes for request and response structures.

classes.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PostFundsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response schema for creating a fund, containing a resource ID.

classes.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PutFundsFundIdRequest
classes.description: Represents the request schema for updating or creating a fund with a specific ID, including name and external ID.

classes.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PutFundsFundIdResponse
classes.description: Represents the response schema for updating a fund, including resource ID and changes.

methods.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PostFundsResponse
methods.description: Defines the schema for a POST response when creating a fund, primarily an identifier.

methods.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PutFundsFundIdRequest
methods.description: Defines the schema for a PUT request for a specific fund, including the fund name and external ID.

methods.name: FundsApiResourceSwagger.PutFundsFundIdResponse
methods.description: Defines the schema for response after updating or creating a fund with specific ID.
